name: MicroDuck Courier
description: Pick, carry, and place a duck-scale paperback in a simulated MicroDuck apartment.
details: Custom Mjlab-Courier-Flat-MicroDuck task with an apartment scene, book, seated reader, and one ONNX export. The source reports 16/16 and 32/32 successful simulated delivery runs. The task-specific command slots carry book and reader targets; no physical robot deployment is documented.

verification.summary: Successful simulated courier runs are documented in the source; no physical hardware evidence is listed.
verification.notes: The source repository includes the Apache-2.0 microduck_rl component but no separate top-level artifact license. No physical robot deployment is claimed.

contract.actuator_model: Dynamixel XL330 (BAM M6 voltage control law)
